compose_gtn_graphs: compose two gtn Graph transducers and verify the resulting graph is isomorphic to expected
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a gtn Graph using gtn.forward_score to get log-sum-exp of all paths
compute_viterbi_path: compute the viterbi best path through a gtn Graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
concatenate_gtn_graphs: concatenate multiple gtn Graph objects into a single graph using gtn.concat to chain languages
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a gtn Graph using gtn.remove to simplify the graph structure
